data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 12.581 million in prior year reserves, primarily driven by adverse claims development related to natural catastrophe events. This included a review of open years' losses following significant storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean and earthquakes in Mexico (referred to as "HIMM" losses) in September 2017. Despite this overall gross strengthening, the report also noted a net positive run-off deviation (release) of GBP 3.714 million, predominantly in Accident & Health and Property business from the 2016 year.
raw_causal_phrases: As a result of claims arising from natural catastrophe in September 2017, the Managing Agent decided to make a cash call on the Corporate Member in respect of certain open years' losses.
The 2017 claims ratio has been adversely impacted by the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter

significant increase in the level of claims activity, with claims incurred at GBP 109m compared to the GBP 68m incurred in 2016. The overriding factor in this has been the storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean in September 2017, compounded by two earthquakes occurring in Mexico, collectively referred to as the "HIMM" losses where the syndicate had exposure in the property, marine and contingency classes.
data.data_quality_notes: The report states a 'positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k' (net release) on page 35, predominantly in Accident and Health and Property business. However, the 'Change in prior year provisions' in the Technical Provisions table on page 40 shows a gross strengthening of GBP 12,581k (net strengthening of GBP 10,116k). The table value for gross prior year development is prioritized as it is a direct gross movement in provisions, but the narrative discrepancy is noted.
